mom.text: The Invasion Tree stands on Mirrodin as a proud testament to Elesh Norn's triumphs, filled by Jin-Gitaxias's army, when Elspeth falls through the planes and lands there.
Its branches send waves of Phyrexians outward, and defenders at Sea Gate under Tazri face them, while sections of the Ravnican Undercity are torn open and thrust skyward by the branches.

Beside it, Elspeth is remade as an angel and holds off Norn and Jin-Gitaxias while Nissa pursues the fleeing group, until Wrenn melds into Realmbreaker, which rejects her, and Chandra pulls Wrenn's fire into herself so that Wrenn can shape it.

Afterward the tree's branches shrivel as angels with Halo are unleashed into the Multiverse through the portals, and with Atraxa dead its barbs retract and the angels see portals open to Theros and decide to go help.
